title: Govern terminology mappings as artefacts with equivalence and provenance
requirements:
- State that maps between SNOMED CT, ICD-11 and LOINC are needed and governed, with context and equivalence properties
- Require mapping purpose, equivalence, versions and validation status
- Require each mapping to state intended purpose, equivalence, direction, source/target versions and limitations
- Cover language variants, local extensions, unmapped concepts and context-dependent mappings with stated equivalence and limitations
- Avoid presenting the blood-pressure codes as unqualified equivalents
- Require human review proportionate to clinical risk for automated mappings
- Require mapping tests against representative data, regression tests and unmapped-content reporting
- Cite the existing LOINC-SNOMED CT interoperability solution
